scope: Owned namespace with Now and standalone Date bridge, conditional global installation, force installation and detection. Default TS uses compact ICU4X lunisolar arithmetic/data and host Intl Umm al-Qura; owned IANA 2026f timezone data remains included. Standalone retains full calendar packs. Forced temporal-polyfill 1.0.7 full/implementation reference uses host Intl data; basic ISO/Gregorian implementation entry measured separately. Legacy formatting corrects stale lunar fields and supports extended non-Gregorian plain values using host labels plus compact CLDR Before Hijrah labels. Size only; prior throughput and primitive WASM profiles remain separate. Bundles are alternatives, not additive.
method: Bazel Rolldown bundles, esbuild es2022 minification, gzip level 9; byte lengths include newline.

publishedGraphs.scope: Required ESM files compressed separately. Consumer bundling can remove unused code. WASM backend delegates ISO/Instant/PlainTime/calendar/timezone/Duration math, plain/zoned/short-date arithmetic, string parsing and date formatting; all16 native calendar tables and IANA records included. Hybrid WASM retains compact TS calendar and owned timezone data; nativeDataWasm omits duplicate TS tables. JS orchestration remains in both. Source maps, declarations and notices are not runtime imports.

primitiveProfile.scope: Matched data-free Instant/Duration primitives only, not full facades or calendars/timezones. Prior throughput measurements remain separate.
